title: VerifyResult
description: Response of GET /v1/receipts/{receipt_id}/verify in SPEC.md: the outcome of verifying a receipt against the published key set.

result.description: The single verification outcome. See examples/README.md for precedence.

key_id.description: The key_id carried by the receipt that was verified.

issued_at.description: The issued_at timestamp carried by the receipt that was verified.
